NurseToolBox

Study and bedside tools for nursing students and nurses, made by Ralph Marco Alonzo. Each app turns a core nursing skill, from concept maps and ABGs to IV math, OB dating, staffing and research, into a step-by-step calculator or guide that shows its work and cites its sources.

NurseMap

Worked concept maps for 35 med-surg diseases, from risk factors to nursing diagnoses.

Open app →

NurseABG

Read any arterial blood gas one step at a time, with a bedside guide and quiz.

Open app →

NurseResearch Pro

Plan a nursing study from research problem to blueprint and choose the right statistical test.

Open app →

NurseIV

Drip rates, medication drips, dose volumes and IV fluids, each with the formula shown.

Open app →

NurseOB

Due date by Naegele's rule, age of gestation and the New Ballard Score, with a quiz.

Open app →

NurseLead

Nurse staffing by patient classification and care hours, checked against DBM ratios, with a shift roster.
